release: Progressive Header Reuse & Thumbnail Phase Telemetry
name: Progressive Header Reuse & Thumbnail Phase Telemetry
changes: Reuses the bounded first-paint OVER/XOVER headers during progressive All Posts background completion so the initial 800-header window is not downloaded a second time.

Adds passive image-thumbnail endpoint phase telemetry for persistent-cache lookup, preview-executor queue wait, per-thumbnail build-lock wait, BODY transfer, native decode, worker time and total endpoint latency, attributed by browsing mode.
Adds render-reason timing/counters so repeated All Posts renders can be attributed to page loads, progressive completion, name-resolution state/retries/results, thumbnail hiding, or other UI causes.

Preserves the v3.6.61 800-header first-paint/chunk limits, preview concurrency, native decode worker sizing, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, terminal-history schema 3, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Discover and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Progressive background completion reuses seed first-paint headers and fetches only missing overlap/page ranges plus genuinely required older Smart Binary expansion.
Seed and fetched overview rows are deduplicated by article number before grouping; completed logical-page semantics and cache-generation safety are unchanged.
Image-thumbnail telemetry remains passive/bounded and does not change preview connection budgets or Collector workload.
Render samples retain the existing aggregate render metric while adding bounded reason-specific timing/counters.
All v3.6.61 and earlier behavioral guards remain mandatory; SAB 5.1.2 and terminal-history schema 3 remain unchanged.
